caption:
Warm modern luxury ✨

Soft ivory seating, warm wood tones, stone-look coffee table aur layered lighting—living aur dining ko ek coordinated look dete hain.

Design tip: pehle room measurements aur walking space check karein; phir sofa size, dining placement aur lighting final karein.

Design consultation ke liye designinfra.in visit karein.
